title: Build a schedule from the data up
task: Turn `sessions` into a conference schedule: one section per day, in the order the days first appear, headed by the day's name. Each day lists its sessions with the time and title, and "with <speaker>" when the session has a speaker. Breaks have no speaker.
hints: Sketch the tree first. One reasonable split is `Schedule` → `DaySection` (one per day) → `SessionItem` (one per session).
Group before rendering. Loop over `sessions` and push each one into an array for its day, keeping days in first-seen order. A `Map<string, Session[]>` remembers insertion order for you.
Render the groups with `Array.from(byDay, ([day, daySessions]) => )`. In `SessionItem`, show the speaker with `{session.speaker !== null && with {session.speaker}}`.
